photos.c: Left: Unbeaten at British league A String 200 metre running in 2002, Graham Beasley was also a prolific points scorer in the 100 metres and relays. Here he anchors the Belgrave 4 x 400m squad in the last race of the day - the Golden Jubilee Cup final. He came from behind for yet another win.
